description: This file defines the class Crypt_Blowfish, which provides implementation of the Blowfish encryption algorithm in PHP, including methods for setting the key, encrypting, and decrypting data. It serves as a cryptographic utility within the project.

classes.name: Crypt_Blowfish
classes.description: A class implementing the Blowfish encryption algorithm with methods for encrypting, decrypting, and key management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Blowfish object with a secret key.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets and initializes the encryption key for the Blowfish algorithm, including key schedule generation.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a string using Blowfish encryption.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts a string previously encrypted with Blowfish.
